For as many as are led by the spirit of
God, they are the sons of God.
There it is. Now, remember the question
said, "Why can't you just be led by the
spirit?" The spirit, what is the spirit?
The spirit is the word of God. So, if
you saying you being led by the spirit,
what spirit are you referring to? All
right, because according to the Bible,
the spirit is the word of God.
